item.text:
Bottom line: mostly yes, with a caveat. Scholz did choose a number of capable, technocratic, and institutionally legitimate people in 2024 and used formal staffing and review mechanisms to keep key programs moving. The main counterweight is that he also leaned on trusted insiders, and by late 2024 the coalition’s collapse limited how far capable staffing could still matter.

### Evidence For
- [Scholz names Jörg Kukies as finance minister amid coalition crisis](https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/11/07/scholz-names-finance-minister-amid-germanys-ruling-coalition-crisis-reports-claim) | Euronews | 7 Nov 2024 | Kukies was presented as an experienced technocrat with finance and Chancellery background, indicating Scholz sought execution capacity rather than a purely political loyalist. | 8B.4, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Biography of Jörg Kukies](https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Monatsberichte/Ausgabe/2024/11/Kapitel/kapitel-2-interview.html) | Bundesministerium der Finanzen | 21 Nov 2024 | The finance ministry described Kukies as a seasoned policy professional with BMF, Chancellery, G7/G20, and finance experience. That is direct evidence of a competence-first appointment. | 8B.4, 8B.2
- [Federal President appoints Kukies under Article 64](https://www.bundespraesident.de/SharedDocs/Termine/DE/Frank-Walter-Steinmeier/2024/11/241107-Entlassungen-Ernennung-Minister.html) | Bundespräsident | 7 Nov 2024 | After Lindner’s dismissal, Scholz proposed Kukies and Steinmeier appointed him through the constitutional procedure. This shows Scholz using formal state machinery to staff a crisis post with a qualified replacement. | 8B.4, 8B.2, 8B.3
- [Budget 2025 and growth initiative](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116) | Federal Government | 5 Jul 2024 | Scholz, Habeck, and Lindner agreed a concrete 49-measure package on modernization, infrastructure, tax relief, social housing, renewables, and growth. That implies he could still get capable coalition actors to negotiate and implement a structured program. | 8B.4, 8B.2, 8B.3
- [Summer press conference 2024](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040) | Federal Government | 24 Jul 2024 | Scholz said the growth initiative had 49 individual measures and linked it to spending, welfare-state stabilization, Bundeswehr funding, and Ukraine support. This is evidence that he was translating priorities into an actionable governing team and budget. | 8B.4, 8B.2, 8B.3
- [National Security Strategy](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356) | Federal Government | 14 Jun 2023, operative in 2024 | Scholz’s security strategy explicitly mobilized diplomacy, police, fire brigades, civil protection, cyber security, supply chains, and pandemic prevention across levels of government. That is strong evidence of empowering a whole-of-state capability structure. | 8B.4, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Bundeswehr mission review](https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958) | Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence | 26 Jun 2024 | The government evaluated overseas missions using uniform criteria and identified improvements such as better civilian-military coordination and more realistic goals. This shows Scholz’s government using competent administrators to review and improve execution. | 8B.4, 8B.2, 8B.3
- [AI and 5G security timetable](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307122) | Bundesregierung | 13 Oct 2024 | Scholz tied AI regulation and 5G security to safer investment conditions and fixed timetables for removing risky components. That suggests he empowered officials to carry out a clear regulatory sequence rather than leaving policy vague. | 8B.4, 8B.2
- [Executive footprint and synopsis reform](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572) | Bundesregierung | 6 Mar 2024 | The cabinet adopted procedural reforms to trace draft laws and outside influence. This is evidence that Scholz backed administrative systems that make execution and oversight more reliable. | 8B.4, 8B.2
- [Bundestag budget session on social priorities](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2023/kw27-de-regierungsbefragung-954170) | Deutscher Bundestag | 31 Jan 2024 | Scholz tied the budget to Bürgergeld, Wohngeld, child benefit, child supplement, and children’s basic security. That is a sign he used formal state channels and working officials to implement his social program. | 8B.4, 8B.2

### Evidence Against
- [Scholz names Jörg Kukies as finance minister amid coalition crisis](https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/11/07/scholz-names-finance-minister-amid-germanys-ruling-coalition-crisis-reports-claim) | Euronews | 7 Nov 2024 | Kukies was also described as a close adviser, so trust and personal proximity clearly mattered. That weakens any claim that Scholz relied only on arm’s-length merit selection. | 8B.4
- [Scholz and the Warburg/Cum-Ex inquiry](https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/geheimes-kanzleramts-gutachten-in-cum-ex-affare-scholz-darf-weiter-in-deckung-bleiben-11756357.html) | Tagesspiegel | 4 Jun 2024 | Reporting suggested the Chancellery used a legal memo to blunt scrutiny around the Warburg affair. That points to reliance on close-circle containment rather than clean empowerment of transparent institutions. | 8B.4, 7B.10
- [5G security decision handled confidentially](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) | Reuters via onvista | 23 May 2024 | The 5G process was handled in confidential interministerial talks with no public comment in real time. That is a real transparency weakness around a sensitive file, even if it does not prove incompetence or bad faith. | 8B.4, 8B.2
- [BND surveillance ruling](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | The Court found parts of the surveillance framework unconstitutional and oversight inadequate. That is structural evidence that some coercive-administrative capacity remained insufficiently controlled, which weakens confidence in clean empowerment of security officials. | 8B.4, 8B.3
- [Coalition collapse explainer](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) | Reuters | 6 Nov 2024 | Reuters reported that firing Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos. Even if Scholz chose a competent replacement, the broader staffing and coalition system was visibly breaking down. | 8B.4, 8B.3
- [No-confidence vote](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198) | Deutscher Bundestag | 16 Dec 2024 | Parliament withdrew confidence by a large margin, confirming that Scholz’s team could no longer sustain governing authority. That is direct evidence that empowerment of the ruling network was no longer effective by year-end. | 8B.4, 8B.3
- [Bundestag questions on the 49 measures](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1034192) | Deutscher Bundestag | 17 Dec 2024 | Parliament was still asking how many of the 49 measures had actually been implemented and what growth effect to expect. This suggests the program existed, but execution capacity remained contested. | 8B.4, 8B.2
- [Coalition chaos after Lindner dismissal](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828) | Reuters | 8 Nov 2024 | Scholz was reduced to managing a debate over election timing and denied trying to force through his own agenda. That reads more like crisis containment than effective empowerment of a cohesive governing team. | 8B.4, 8B.3

### Search Gap
I found strong evidence that Scholz picked capable technocrats and used formal institutions to staff and run parts of the program. I found weaker evidence for a durable loyalist cadre or a deeply empowered ruling network, and the late-2024 coalition collapse limited how far personnel choices could translate into stable execution.
